name: major_pco
description: The Poule-Canard-Oie major event started through sgp.majeurs:pco/_start on a synthetic location set, with every actor dispatched into the three teams and standing on the arena grid, so minecraft:execute_repeating_functions runs the real per-tick round: three looking_at raycast predicates over all players, the refuge check and actionbar segment per participant, the cage checks and the win checks.
